cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your bow at the ceremony was adequate. Mine follows the founder's original diagram.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The founder asked us to wave instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. His original diagram is in the constitution. My bow follows that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you have a signed exception. I'll bow on behalf of everyone still governed by the constitution.
